scripts.dev:app: trap 'pnpm run stop:qdrant; pnpm run stop:minio; pnpm run stop:rabbitmq' EXIT INT TERM; pnpm run dev:qdrant && pnpm run dev:minio && pnpm run dev:rabbitmq && turbo run dev --filter=backend --filter=search-flow-service --filter=data-ingestion --filter=embedding-service --filter=sharepoint-webhook --filter=file-storage-service --parallel
scripts.dev:qdrant: docker rm -f qdrant 2>/dev/null; docker ps -q --filter publish=6333 | xargs -r docker rm -f; docker run -d -p 6333:6333 -p 6334:6334 -v $(pwd)/services/embedding-service/qdrant_data:/qdrant/storage:z --name qdrant qdrant/qdrant && echo 'Qdrant started at http://localhost:6333/dashboard'
scripts.dev:minio: docker rm -f minio 2>/dev/null; docker ps -q --filter publish=9000 | xargs -r docker rm -f; docker run -d -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -e MINIO_ROOT_USER=minioadmin -e MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=minioadmin --name minio minio/minio server /data --console-address ':9001' && echo 'MinIO started at http://localhost:9001'
scripts.dev:rabbitmq: docker rm -f rabbitmq 2>/dev/null; docker ps -q --filter publish=5672 | xargs -r docker rm -f; docker run -d -p 5672:5672 -p 15672:15672 --name rabbitmq rabbitmq:3-management && echo 'RabbitMQ started at http://localhost:15672'
